results.title: Samagra Data Breach Raises Security Concerns Over 8 Crore MP Citizens’ Records
results.description: Cyber police are investigating a reported data breach in Madhya Pradesh’s Samagra portal, which holds records of around eight crore citizens. The probe began after unauthorised data changes were detected. Officials have tightened security and are examining who accessed the portal and whether the breach was aimed at causing damage or making money.
